product_name_specific: ACQUA DI CIQ EAU DE PARFUM
risk_description: According to the list of ingredients, the product contains 2-(4-tert-butylbenzyl) propionaldehyde (BMHCA), which is prohibited in cosmetic products. BMHCA may harm the reproductive system, may harm the health of the unborn child and may cause skin sensitisation.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Cosmetic Products Regulation.
